headline: LAD @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.02 at PIT 4.65, with a projected total of 8.67. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Nick Gonzales, Andy Pages, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Davis Wendzel because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
